title: ModelProfile
description: Capability profile referenced by an AgentManifest (never a concrete model name). Bound to concrete provider/model pairs by a ModelPolicyBundle, versioned in Git, not in code.

priority.description: Lower = tried first; drives fallback cascade.

cost_per_million_input_tokens.description: OBS-003 FinOps: real USD rate per 1M input/prompt tokens. Only meaningful when cost_model=token_based; list pricing is a starting point, confirm against your actual provider contract.

cost_per_million_output_tokens.description: OBS-003 FinOps: real USD rate per 1M output/completion tokens. Only meaningful when cost_model=token_based.

data_sensitivity.description: restricted forces provider=prometheus_inference only (never leaves the network).
